headline: Evening Dušičky pass on 1 Nov. I re-checked the 205 churches left unverifiable this morning, plus Plzeň Domeček, for 2 Nov only. Four were wrong (each a missing Mass) and all four are fixed and live. Batch 1 went live at about 18:12 CET, roughly 10 minutes in. Two of the four were the corrections held back this morning (Podolí, Strakonice); their sources load normally tonight.

shipped.title: Dušičky 2026 evening pass, batch 1: 3 sourced corrections for 2 Nov (Praha-Podolí 15:00, Strakonice sv. Václav 16:30, Ostrava-Krásné Pole 18:00)
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 ~17:12 UTC (18:12 CET) at 390 px, no horizontal scroll. /kostel/1000109/, /kostel/4000712934772/ and /kostel/5000911872019/ show 'tomorrow' 15:00, 16:30 and 18:00 mše sv. /dusicky/praha/ lists Podolí 15:00 on 2 Nov as 'mimořádná, zapsaná na tento den'.

shipped.title: Dušičky 2026 evening pass, batch 2: Brno-Slatina sv. Kříž 18:00 on 2 Nov
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 ~17:16 UTC (18:16 CET) at 390 px. /kostel/80001507647896/ shows 'tomorrow 18:00 mše sv.' /dusicky/brno/ lists Slatina 18:00 on 2 Nov as 'mimořádná'.

notes: Scope: all 205 churches marked unverifiable in docs/review/2026-11-01-dusicky-check.json, 2 Nov only, plus Plzeň Domeček (already fixed this morning; the open question was its 18:00). Unit = a church. Results: 6 confirmed, 4 wrong, 4 fixed, 195 still unverifiable, plus Domeček's 18:00 = 196.

Timing: the container clock and the Pages server's Date header agreed. Start 17:01 UTC (18:01 CET). The first sweep of all 205 was done by about 17:10 UTC. A second sweep of the 121 that weren't walled ran 17:13–17:17 UTC and found nothing new. I stopped at about 18:20 CET, well before the 22:00 limit, because the second sweep came back empty. I had no way to wait for later posts without scheduling tools.
Order: Praha, Brno, Ostrava, Plzeň, Olomouc first, then the rest. The checks ran in six parallel groups.

Wrong and fixed (4, all a missing 2 Nov Mass): Praha-Podolí sv. Michael 15:00 (farnostbranik.cz post for 2 Nov 2026), Strakonice sv. Václav 16:30 (parish calendar plus the 2026 Dušičky .doc), Ostrava-Krásné Pole sv. Hedvika 18:00 (Pustkovec November schedule JPG), Brno-Slatina sv. Kříž 18:00 (church page plus the church's Google Calendar event dated 2026-11-02).

Confirmed (6): Praha-Nusle sv. Václav (no Mass; the parish's only 2 Nov Mass is sv. Pankrác 18:00, which the site already shows), Ostrava cathedral 18:00 (bishop's calendar; 07:30 neither confirmed nor ruled out), Opava konkatedrála 6:00 and 7:00, Opava sv. Vojtěch and kaple sv. Kříže (no Mass; Cesta 11/2026), Henčlov kaple sv. Martina (no Mass; Troubky week sheet).

Held items from this morning: Podolí and Strakonice are fixed (see decisions). For Plzeň Domeček there is no change: the Věstník 11/2026 rota gives Monday 18:00 in Domeček, but the parish's own 2 Nov list names only Bolevec 15:00 and Roudná 18:00, and the friars' site has nothing newer. So 18:00 is not added; 17:30 stays dropped.

Leads that don't meet the rule because the church isn't named (left unverifiable, not changed): Třebíč Horka-Domky, where the 1. 11. 2026 ohlášky say 'V pondělí bude mše sv. také v 16:00 na hřbitově'. Klatovy Narození P. Marie, where the Dušičky PDF says only 'KLATOVY' (7:30, 17:00). Brno-Líšeň sv. Jiljí, where the intention calendar gives 07:00, 08:00 and 18:00 with no place. Brno-Lesná kaple sv. Ludmily, where the ohlášky say 'mše svaté v 7.00 a v 18.00' with no place. Praha-Nebušice, where the ohlášky say 10:00 in the cemetery chapel and 18:00 'v kostele', and neither is sv. Jan Nepomucký, Dejvice. Praha-Dejvice chapels, where the PDF says only 'Pondělí 2.11. 17:00'.

Bot walls, not worked around: about 70 of the 205. Unchanged from this morning: all České Budějovice parishes, Cheb, Příbram, Zlín, Kroměříž, Uherské Hradiště, Trutnov, HK Pražské Předměstí, Frýdek, Havířov, Český Těšín, Ostrava-Přívoz, Moravská Ostrava (WEDOS), Komín, Žabovřesky, Stodůlky, Hloubětín, Lhotka, Hostivař, Kbely, Plzeň-Skvrňany (fma.cz). New tonight: opatstvibrno.cz now answers 403 'Byl zjištěn malware' (Staré Brno basilica, sv. Alžběta, sv. Leopold a Václav). zabrdovice.cz and svatymichalbrno.cz answered 429 in the second sweep. Česká Lípa's Google calendar answered 429. Strakonice (466 this morning) and farnostbranik.cz (WAF this morning) loaded normally for me and for the reviewer.

Nothing posted for 2 Nov yet (by about 18:20 CET): Teplice ('Ohlášky doposud nebyly zveřejněny'), Opava minorites, farnost-litomerice.cz, Zábrdovice, Husovice, Soběšice, Plzeň-Bory, Košíře, Modřany, sv. Jindřich, Bohnice, Střešovice, Na Balkáně, sv. Vojtěch Dejvice, the Augustinians at Malá Strana, and most Olomouc-area chapels. Krnov, Jihlava and Litoměřice cathedral posted ohlášky with no 2 Nov Mass times.

Registry problems seen, not changed: Děčín sv. Kříž's undated schedule says Monday 7.00, while the site has 07:30. Česká Lípa sv. Máří Magdaléna shows 17:30 on 2 Nov, but this morning's calendar check found no Monday Mass there. The Slatina page has a typo, 'čtvrtek 4.11.', which should be 5.11 (the ICS has the 5th).

Review: each batch had an independent subagent re-fetch every source and check the 2026 date, church, time and quote. Batch 1: 3/3 OK. Batch 2: 1/1 OK. Images and .doc files were read directly (by eye or after converting to text). Data only; no code changed. data/corrections.test.mjs passed locally and in CI. corrections.json now has 110 entries.
Per-church results with source and note: docs/review/2026-11-01-evening-check.json.

decisions.question: Podolí and Strakonice: this morning's reviewer couldn't reach the source. Tonight the same sources load. Ship on them, or require a second, different source?
options: ship if the independent reviewer can read the source tonight
require a second source on a different site
decisions.default_taken: ship if the reviewer can read it (the reviewer did: OK on both)
decisions.why: The rule is 'a source both checkers can read'. Strakonice also has a second confirmation on the parish calendar page. Podolí's own site has nothing dated, so the Braník post is the only source. Taking a row out is a one-entry revert.

decisions.question: Krásné Pole's November JPG prints no year
options: count it as 2026 (weekdays fit, 29.11 = 1. neděle adventní, uploaded under /2026/11/)
hold it like this morning's undated Brno-Slatina schedule
decisions.why: It's a dated monthly programme, not a standing schedule. 29 Nov as the 1st Sunday of Advent fits 2026, not 2020. The reviewer agreed.

decisions.question: Brno-Slatina was held this morning because the page shows no year
options: ship, using the church's own Google Calendar event dated 2026-11-02 18:00 for the year
decisions.why: The calendar gives the dated record the rule asks for, and it matches the page.

decisions.question: Notices that give 2 Nov times without naming the church (Třebíč 'na hřbitově', Klatovy 'KLATOVY', Líšeň, Lesná, Nebušice, Dejvice)
decisions.why: Same rule as 28 Oct and this morning. A wrong place is worse than a missing row.

decisions.question: Plzeň Domeček 18:00
options: add it from the regular November rota
decisions.why: The parish's own 2 Nov list doesn't name Domeček. The same friars have Roudná at 18:00.

decisions.question: Note text on the added rows
options: copy the source's phrase (e.g. 'za všechny věrné zemřelé')
decisions.why: 79 of the existing entries use it, and the row wording is Pavol's call.

decisions.question: Merge with the android CI job still running
options: merge on the gate (the test job: typecheck · test · build)
decisions.why: AGENTS.md says 'Block only on these.' The diffs are data only.

decisions.question: Stop early or keep re-checking until 22:00
decisions.why: The second sweep found nothing new. Waiting for later posts would need scheduling tools, which the brief rules out.

decisions.question: node_modules is committed as a symlink, and npm ci replaced it locally
decisions.why: Same as this morning; it's outside the data pass.

next: Optional late sweep around 20:30–21:00 CET or at 06:00 on 2 Nov over the parishes with nothing posted (Teplice, Opava minorites, Litoměřice, Zábrdovice, Husovice, Bory, Košíře, Bohnice and the rest listed in data_check.notes). Fixes for evening Masses would still land in time.
Pavol's call: relax the 'church named' rule for single-cemetery-church towns? Třebíč Horka-Domky 16:00 and Klatovy 17:00 are the clearest cases.
Pavol's call: a browser pass for the about 70 walled churches (České Budějovice, Zlín, Cheb and others). They are walls, not missing notices.
Add tonight's registry problems (Děčín sv. Kříž 7:00 vs 07:30, Česká Lípa sv. Máří Magdaléna Monday 17:30) to the ČBK data-quality list. Sending it is outreach, so that part is Pavol's.
After 2 Nov: the dated one-offs expire on their own (corrections for past dates are skipped). No clean-up needed.
